snippet.title: myDU: Dual Universe without subscription
snippet.description:
Play Dual Universe without subscription with myDU, the standalone version of our building sandbox MMO in space featuring cutting-edge voxel technology!

The myDU version allows you to host your own Dual Universe server, or to connect to other players’ private servers. You can give yourself unlimited resources to build anything, disable PvP (or create a full PvP server, play solo or with selected friends. Play your way in myDU!

Please Note: while myDU provides full access to Dual Universe, it does not include access to the MMO server!

PLAY myDU: https://www.dualuniverse.game/buy

Want to try the MMO server? PLAY DU: https://www.dualuniverse.game

Dual Universe is a continuous, single-shard MMORPG that takes place in a multi-planetary, sci-fi world that features a player-driven economy, politics, trade, and warfare. Players can freely modify the world by creating structures, spaceships, and even orbital stations, giving rise to empires and civilizations.

Join the community:
Official forum: https://board.dualthegame.com
Community portal: https://community.dualthegame.com/

Follow us on:
Instagram:   / dualthegame  
Twitter:   / dualuniverse  
Twitch:   / dualuniverse  
Facebook:   / dualuniverse  
Soundcloud:   / dualuniverse
